Cis-pQTL Mendelian Randomization and Colocalization Heatmap

Source: R/type_mr_coloc.R
type_mr_coloc.Rd

Creates publication-ready Mendelian Randomization (MR) and Bayesian colocalization heatmaps (Clinical Archetype 36) for evaluating causal genetic links between molecular exposures (e.g. plasma pQTLs, eQTLs, or single-cell marker signatures) and complex disease endpoints.

Evaluates Wald ratio effect sizes (Z-score or beta) as a diverging gradient, overlays odds ratios where p < 0.05, outlines tiles passing multiple-testing thresholds (e.g. Bonferroni), places corner glyphs for robust colocalization (PP.H4 >= 0.80), and mutes discordant associations (PP.H3 >= 0.80, such as MHC/HLA linkage disequilibrium artifacts) in italicized grey text.

Usage

type_mr_coloc(
  beta_col = NULL,
  se_col = NULL,
  z_col = NULL,
  p_col = NULL,
  or_col = NULL,
  pp4_col = NULL,
  pp3_col = NULL,
  fdr_col = NULL,
  set_col = NULL,
  family_col = NULL,
  p_threshold = 0.05,
  bonferroni = TRUE,
  coloc_threshold = 0.8,
  discordant_threshold = 0.8,
  text_size = 2,
  text_format = "%.2f",
  glyph_shape = 17,
  glyph_size = 1,
  glyph_nudge = c(0.36, 0.3),
  colors = c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"),
  limits = c(-6, 6),
  fill_name = "z of Wald ratio",
  border_color = "grey85",
  border_linewidth = 0.25,
  frame_color = "black",
  frame_linewidth = 0.55,
  show_caption = TRUE,
  caption = NULL,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL
)

Arguments

beta_col

Column name for MR effect estimate (beta or Wald ratio).

se_col

Column name for standard error of the MR estimate.

z_col

Column name for Z-score (beta / SE). Auto-computed if beta_col and se_col are present.

p_col

Column name for association p-value.

or_col

Column name for odds ratio per SD (or effect size for text display).

pp4_col

Column name for colocalization posterior probability of hypothesis 4 (shared causal variant, \(\text{PP.H4}\)).

pp3_col

Column name for colocalization posterior probability of hypothesis 3 (distinct causal variants / LD artifact, \(\text{PP.H3}\)).

fdr_col

Column name for FDR-adjusted q-value.

set_col

Column name for exposure grouping (e.g. marker protein class: effector vs memory).

family_col

Column name for outcome disease family (e.g. Cardiovascular, Allergic, Autoimmune).

p_threshold

Numeric p-value threshold for displaying numerical effect sizes inside tiles (default 0.05).

bonferroni

Logical or numeric. If TRUE (default), computes 0.05 / N over all pairs and draws a prominent black border around significant tiles. If numeric, uses the specified threshold. Set to FALSE to disable.

coloc_threshold

Minimum PP.H4 to display the colocalization corner triangle glyph (default 0.80).

discordant_threshold

Minimum PP.H3 to format text as muted italic grey (default 0.80), flagging distinct variants in the same locus.

text_size

Font size for numbers inside tiles (default 2.0).

text_format

String format for effect numbers (default "%.2f").

glyph_shape

Point shape for colocalization marker (default 17, solid triangle).

glyph_size

Size of colocalization corner marker (default 1.0).

glyph_nudge

Numeric vector of length 2 specifying x and y nudge for the corner glyph (default c(0.36, 0.30)).

colors

Diverging color gradient vector of length 3 (low, mid, high). Default c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B").

limits

Symmetrical color scale limits for \(Z\)-score (default c(-6, 6)). Values beyond are squished.

fill_name

Legend title for color gradient (default "z of Wald ratio").

border_color

Grid border color between tiles (default "grey85").

border_linewidth

Grid line width between tiles (default 0.25).

frame_color

Outline color for Bonferroni-significant tiles (default "black").

frame_linewidth

Outline stroke width for Bonferroni-significant tiles (default 0.55).

show_caption

Logical. If TRUE (default), appends a standardized publication caption explaining numbers, frames, triangles, and italicized text.

caption

Optional override caption string.

xlab, ylab

Axis labels.

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(cliomicplot)
data(pqtl_mr_coloc)

# Full multi-panel MR & Colocalization matrix
cliplot(
  symbol ~ label_short,
  data = pqtl_mr_coloc,
  type = type_mr_coloc(
    set_col = "set_label",
    family_col = "family_label",
    p_threshold = 0.05,
    bonferroni = TRUE,
    coloc_threshold = 0.80
  ),
  title = "Cis-pQTL Mendelian Randomization & Colocalization Matrix",
  subtitle = "UKB-PPP Plasma Proteomics vs FinnGen R12 Endpoints"
)
} # }
